description: Implementation of MojoDataPipeReader and MojoDataPipeWriter classes for reading and writing data through Mojo data pipes, including error handling and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: MojoDataPipeReader
classes.description: Handles reading data asynchronously from a Mojo data pipe, with error handling and callback support.

classes.name: MojoDataPipeWriter
classes.description: Handles writing data asynchronously to a Mojo data pipe, with error handling and callback support.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::MojoDataPipeReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reader with a consumer handle and starts watching for new data.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::CompleteCurrentRead
methods.description: Completes the current read operation and invokes the callback.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::Read
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous read operation from the data pipe.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::TryReadData
methods.description: Attempts to read data from the pipe, handling errors and partial reads.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::OnPipeError
methods.description: Handles errors encountered during pipe operations.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeReader::IsPipeValid
methods.description: Checks if the consumer handle is valid.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::MojoDataPipeWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with a producer handle and starts watching for writability.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::Write
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous write operation to the data pipe.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::TryWriteData
methods.description: Attempts to write data to the pipe, handling errors and partial writes.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::CompleteCurrentWrite
methods.description: Completes the current write operation and invokes the callback.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::OnPipeError
methods.description: Handles errors encountered during pipe operations.

methods.name: MojoDataPipeWriter::IsPipeValid
methods.description: Checks if the producer handle is valid.
